name: AGRA (Alliance for a Green Revolution in Africa)
program: Requests for Concept Notes (sustainable farming, climate adaptation, water-smart value chains)
collect_note: Reads AGRA's Requests for Concept Notes table (server-rendered WordPress page): one row per RFCN with title, deadline and status, linked to the call document. Rows are stored as candidates (auto_vet false) because many RFCNs are youth-jobs or market calls outside SALSAV scope; the dashboard shows only the ones confirmed on step 8.

sample.title: REQUEST FOR CONCEPT NOTES (RFCN): Building Resilient Livelihoods Through Water-Smart Value Chains in Sub-Saharan Africa Drylands

evidence: 2026-11-20: GET https://agra.org/opportunities/concept-notes/ HTTP 200, table #opportunities-list lists about 25 RFCNs with Deadline and Status columns. Channels tried: endpoint_recon found /feed/ (WordPress blog posts, no calls), /wp-json/wp/v2/opportunity (774 records mixing vacancies, procurement and RFCNs, excerpt empty and no deadline field, so rejected as a source), no calls API, no sitemap needed. HTML list chosen. Each RFCN PDF carries its own timeline; Water-Smart RFCN PDF states deadline 23/Jul/2026, matching the table.
